title: Judicial Review Scope
description: Extent of Supreme Court authority to strike down Knesset laws.

title: Judicial Appointments
description: Who controls appointment of Supreme Court justices.

title: Override Clause
description: Ability of Knesset to override Supreme Court rulings.

title: Attorney General Independence
description: Independence of the Attorney General from government.

title: Income Tax Progressivity
description: Whether top income tax brackets should be raised.

title: State Welfare Spending
description: Level of state social safety net and welfare benefits.

title: Housing Market Regulation
description: Government intervention in housing prices and rental market.

title: Religious Institution Funding
description: State budget allocation to religious institutions.

title: Civil Marriage
description: Whether civil (non-religious) marriage should be legalized.

title: Shabbat Commerce
description: Whether businesses may operate on Shabbat.

title: Haredi Military Service
description: Whether Haredi men should serve in the military.

title: Kashrut Law
description: State enforcement of kashrut (kosher) rules.

title: Two-State Solution
description: Support for Palestinian statehood alongside Israel.

title: Settlement Expansion
description: Policy on West Bank settlement building.

title: Defense Budget
description: Level of military and defense spending.

title: Gaza Ceasefire Terms
description: Conditions acceptable for Gaza ceasefire agreement.

title: Basic Necessities Subsidies
description: Direct government subsidies to reduce the cost of food and basic consumer goods.

title: VAT Exemptions on Essentials
description: Removing or reducing VAT on essential goods like bread, milk, and vegetables.
directional_axis: vat_exemptions: -1=broad product exemptions, +1=uniform VAT on all goods

title: School Choice Vouchers
description: State vouchers allowing parents to choose private or charter schools.

title: Core Curriculum in Religious Schools
description: Requirement for state-funded yeshivot to teach secular core subjects.

title: Carbon Tax
description: Imposing a carbon tax on large industrial emitters to reduce greenhouse gas output.
directional_axis: carbon_tax: -1=strict emission regulations/tax, +1=economic growth over climate

title: Offshore Gas Extraction
description: Accelerating offshore natural gas extraction to maximize state revenue.
directional_axis: gas_extraction: -1=limit extraction/transition to renewables, +1=maximize gas revenues

title: PM Under Indictment
description: Whether a Prime Minister under criminal indictment must temporarily leave office.
directional_axis: pm_indictment: -1=PM must suspend on indictment, +1=PM may serve through trial

title: State Comptroller Independence
description: Degree to which the state comptroller operates independently from the governing coalition.

title: Public vs Private Healthcare
description: Government funding for public hospitals vs expanding private supplemental medicine.

title: Mental Health Funding
description: Level of state budget dedicated to mental health services.

title: Public Affordable Housing
description: Large-scale government construction of affordable housing to reduce prices.

title: Rent Control
description: Legal caps on annual rent increases to protect tenants.

title: Universal Military Service
description: Whether military service applies equally to ultra-Orthodox and Arab citizens.

title: Mandatory Service Length
description: Whether mandatory military service should be shortened to allow earlier workforce entry.
directional_axis: service_length: -1=shorten service, +1=maintain or extend current length

title: West Bank Annexation
description: Formal Israeli annexation of major settlement blocs in the West Bank.
directional_axis: annexation: -1=oppose annexation, +1=formal annexation of settlement blocs

title: Evacuation-Compensation Law
description: State financial packages for settlers willing to voluntarily leave isolated outposts.
directional_axis: evacuation_comp: -1=support voluntary evacuation with compensation, +1=oppose any evacuation

title: Public Transit Investment
description: Prioritizing mass public transit (rail, BRT, metro) over new highway construction.
directional_axis: public_transit: -1=major public transit investment, +1=rely on private cars/highways

title: High-Speed Intercity Rail
description: Building a high-speed rail network connecting all major Israeli cities.
directional_axis: hsr: -1=prioritize high-speed rail, +1=highway expansion over rail

title: Guaranteed Minimum Income
description: A guaranteed minimum income (negative income tax) for all working-age adults.
directional_axis: minimum_income: -1=support guaranteed minimum income, +1=oppose / cut welfare

title: Universal Child Allowance
description: Significantly increasing universal child allowances paid to all families.
directional_axis: child_allowance: -1=expand universal allowance, +1=means-test or reduce allowance

title: LGBTQ+ Rights
description: Legal equality and recognition of LGBTQ+ persons.

title: Arab Minority Rights
description: Language rights, political participation, budget parity for Arab citizens.
directional_axis: arab_rights: -1=full equality and recognition, +1=restrict political participation

title: Freedom of Press
description: Independence of public broadcasting and press freedom.

title: Anti-Discrimination Law
description: Scope of anti-discrimination protections in employment and services.
